marta: Quick follow-up on postmortem action items. We need explicit owners, acceptance criteria, and a handoff plan. Proposal: weekly sherpa + 48h overlap. Initial tickets: RW-3402, RW-3405, RW-3410. Who can take week 1?
jess: I can take week 1. I'll own RW-3402 (kv-cache backpressure) and RW-3410 (ingest throttle tuning).
liam: I can be secondary on RW-3405 (alert flapping). happy to add smoke tests.
priya: Jess please add rollback steps and exact dashboard queries for post-deploy verification. Also add a field 'repeat_pattern' if we see similar incidents within 30d.
jess: adding ACs now: RW-3402 -> "95th latency down by 25% or revert flag within 30min"; RW-3410 -> "no >3% error delta during 24h window". rollback + smoke tests added.
oncall-bot: Reminder: PM action checklist due in 6 days for incident 2024-05-02.
marta: I'll create a parent epic for tracking velocity and SLA. RACI: R=Jess, A=Marta, C=EngSRE/Observability, I=Platform. Backstop=liam for week1.
jira-bot: Created epic RW-3207: "Postmortem remediation sprint - sherpa week1" and linked RW-3402, RW-3405, RW-3410.
liam: I'll tag the tickets with sprint label and add the backstop notes.
marta: Great — daily 15min stand for the week. Jess, post the ticket links when ready and update the postmortem doc. Closing loop here. :white_check_mark:
